# The blocks of one chain, and whether FEATURE_SEALER_V3 is on in each.
# The Rust test crates/exec-core/tests/feature_switch_blocks.rs runs the
# executor rule over these blocks, and the engine test
# the_table_switches_where_the_chain_switches runs the real deposits. Both
# must give the v3 column. A replay of a block of a chain that switched
# reads the flag by this rule.
#
# Columns:
#   block        the block number, from 1
#   ts           the header time of the block in ms: the boundary that
#                closes it. The next block executes with this time.
#   origin       the L1 origin of the block. A block whose origin is above
#                the origin of the block before is the first block of its
#                epoch, and runs the deposits of the epoch.
#   set_feature  the activation times of the setFeature deposits of the
#                feature in the block, in log order and separated by
#                commas, or "-". Only the first block of an epoch holds
#                them. 0 stores the time that the block executes with:
#                on from the next block, except in block 1, which executes
#                with time 0, so its 0 means never (row 1). The last deposit
#                of the block decides the next block.
#   v3           1 when the block runs with the feature on, else 0
#
# block ts origin set_feature v3
1 1000 1 0 0
2 1250 1 - 0
3 1500 2 0 0
4 1750 2 - 1
5 2000 2 - 1
6 2250 3 5000 1
7 2500 3 - 0
8 4750 3 - 0
9 5000 3 - 0
10 5250 3 - 1
11 5500 4 18446744073709551615 1
12 5750 4 - 0
13 100000 4 - 0
14 100250 5 0 0
15 100500 5 - 1
16 100750 6 1000 1
17 101000 6 - 1
18 101250 7 200000 1
19 101500 8 0 0
20 101750 8 - 1
21 102000 9 900000,0 1
22 102250 9 - 1
23 102500 10 0,900000 1
24 102750 10 - 0
